context_rule.per_cluster_vote: modal bucket among exact entry observations; lexical tie-break
context_rule.attach_to_candidate_only_if: same bucket has >=2/3 support among at least 3 qualifying independent clusters with that context available
context_rule.missing_context: does not block core family but cannot become a prospective gate
context_rule.historical_fee_tvl: unavailable unless a point-in-time source is proven; current fee/TVL substitution forbidden
context_rule.token_age: unavailable unless exact creation time is proven; pool age may not substitute for token age

continuous_parameters.range_width_bins: median of cluster-level medians within supported core family
continuous_parameters.center_active_offset_bins: median of cluster-level medians within supported core family
continuous_parameters.hold_seconds: median of cluster-level medians within supported core family
continuous_parameters.rebalance_position_rate: median of cluster-level rates within supported core family

token_age.exact_only_when: mint signature history exhausts within the fixed bound and the earliest successful transaction contains authenticated InitializeMint or InitializeMint2 targeting that mint
token_age.age_definition: entry blockTime minus authenticated mint-initialization transaction blockTime
token_age.wsol: not evaluated as the non-SOL pool token

exit_active_bin.source: authenticated Meteora RemoveLiquidity event in the terminal removal transaction

amendment_history.reason: Freeze exact token-age resolution bounds and authenticated exit-active-bin source before new operator PnL ranking.
